name: angels new you
source:
Linit is a young guy who never really knew what a purpose in life is, he seeks out the local hairdresser to change a bit about his being. There, he finds Danny a charming guy you might get to know a little better as well as Angle, the owner of the shop that you wouldn't want to mess with. 

Have fun!
